lines.text: Taurus calls it patience. Sometimes it's just refusing to leave a bad thing.
lines.caption:
The strength of Taurus is staying power. They do not quit when it gets hard.

But that strength has a shadow. Sometimes they stay long after something has stopped being good, simply because leaving feels harder than enduring. Fixed earth does not like to be moved, even by its own better judgment.

Patience is a virtue. Stubbornness dressed as patience is not.

If you are a Taurus, ask yourself honestly. Am I waiting for this to improve, or just afraid to let go?

lines.text: Venus rules Taurus. They don't love loudly. They love in thread count.
lines.caption:
Taurus is Venus at her most earthly. Pleasure, comfort, beauty you can touch.

They show love through the senses. The good sheets. The meal they spent all afternoon making. A hand on your back when you walk past.

They will not always say it in words. They will make your life softer.

If you are dating a Taurus, look at your surroundings. Chances are, you are being loved in the details.

lines.text: Gemini isn't two-faced. They just have more than one thing to say to you.
lines.caption:
Gemini is mutable air, ruled by Mercury. Their minds move fast and in several directions at once.

That gets misread as inconsistency. It is really curiosity. They are thinking about you from five angles at the same time.

The trick is to enjoy the range rather than try to pin it down.

You will never run out of things to talk about. And that, to a Gemini, is the deepest kind of love.

lines.text: Bore a Gemini once and they'll forgive you. Bore them twice and they're typing.
lines.caption:
Gemini needs stimulation the way some signs need security. Conversation, new ideas, a reason to keep coming back.

They will forgive a lot. A bad date. A forgotten plan. But a relationship that has stopped surprising them? That is hard.

It is not shallowness. Their mind is a fire that needs fuel.

Ask them a question you have never asked. Take them somewhere new. Keep the conversation alive, and they will stay.

lines.text: Gemini needs someone they can talk to at 3am about nothing and everything.
lines.caption:
For a Gemini, conversation is intimacy. Late night talks. Voice notes on the walk home. A text thread that never quite ends.

They want a partner who is curious, quick, and up for the tangent. Someone who can follow a story into three side stories and still remember where it started.

The silent type might look mysterious at first. For a Gemini, mystery gets old fast.

They want the person who answers at 3am with an opinion. That is their kind of romantic.

lines.text: Gemini can talk about anything. Whoever keeps them makes the silence interesting too.
lines.caption:
Gemini can struggle with stillness. When the newness fades and the conversation slows, they get restless.

The partner who keeps them is not the one who entertains them constantly. It is the one who shows them that quiet can be full too. Someone who can sit beside them and let the conversation rest without either of them panicking.

A comfortable silence. A slow Sunday. Reading in the same room.

Gemini, the quiet is not the end of the story. It is where people stop performing and start trusting you. Stay for it.

lines.text: A Gemini will explain their feelings brilliantly. Feeling them is the harder part.
lines.caption:
Mercury gives Gemini a gift for words. They can describe an emotion perfectly. Analyse it. Make a joke about it.

What is harder is sitting with it. A Gemini can talk about a feeling for an hour and still not have let themselves feel it.

They might answer a feeling with a fact, or change the subject when it gets too close.

If you love a Gemini, give them room to talk it through. Then gently ask the second question. The one about how it actually feels.

lines.text: Cancer will feed you before they tell you they love you. Same thing.
lines.caption:
Cancer is cardinal water, ruled by the moon. Home, family, nurture.

They express love through care. A meal. A blanket. A text checking you got home safe. A spare toothbrush. Your favourite snack in their cupboard. The light left on when you are late.

Words might come later. They are careful with words because they mean them.

If a Cancer is feeding you, looking after you, making space for you in their home, you are already loved. You just have not been told yet.

lines.text: Cancer doesn't need grand gestures. They need to know you're not leaving.
lines.caption:
For Cancer, security is everything. Not money or status. Emotional safety. Knowing you will be here tomorrow.

Big romantic moments are lovely, but they do not settle a Cancer heart. A crab needs a shell before it can relax, and you are part of the shell.

What does is consistency. Coming home when you said. Calling when you are late. Choosing them in small ways every day.

Reassure a Cancer, often. It is not neediness. It is how their tide stays calm.

lines.text: A Cancer goes quiet instead of saying it hurt. Ask. They're waiting for you to ask.
lines.caption:
The crab retreats into its shell. That is how Cancer protects itself.

When they are hurt, they rarely say so directly. They get quieter. A little distant. They hope you will notice. They are hoping you care enough to look closer without being asked.

It is not a game. It is fear of being too much.

If your Cancer has gone quiet, do not wait it out. Ask, gently. You will be amazed how quickly they come back out.

lines.text: Cancer's loyalty has no expiry date. Neither does their memory.
lines.caption:
When a Cancer commits, they commit for life. Friends from childhood. Family they will defend to anyone.

That loyalty is fierce. And it comes with a memory to match. They can tell you what you wore on your first date and what you said that hurt in year two.

They remember every kindness. They also remember every hurt.

If you love a Cancer, be careful with them. They will hold onto the good moments for years. Give them plenty.

lines.text: The moon rules Cancer. Their moods change. Their love doesn't.
lines.caption:
Cancer feels everything, and those feelings move like the tide. Up one day, low the next.

It can be confusing if you take each mood as a verdict on the relationship. A Cancer in a low mood is not a Cancer falling out of love. It is just the tide going out.

But underneath the shifting surface, the love stays steady. Cancer is cardinal. Once they choose you, they do not drift.

Ride the waves with them. The sea changes its face. It does not go anywhere.

lines.text: Leo doesn't need you to be impressed. They need you to be glad they're here.
lines.caption:
Leo is fixed fire, ruled by the sun. Warm, generous, built to shine.

People assume Leo wants applause. Sometimes. But underneath it is something simpler. The sun does not need applause to shine. It just likes to be noticed warming things up.

They want to feel that their presence matters. That the room is better because they walked in. That you are happy they chose you.

Tell them. Not with flattery, but with honesty. A Leo who feels welcome will light up your whole life.

lines.text: A Leo in love makes a Tuesday feel like an opening night.
lines.caption:
Leo does not do half-hearted. When they love you, they love you out loud.

The surprise dinner. The compliment in front of friends. The way they make an ordinary evening feel like an event. They plan the birthday months ahead and remember the small thing you said you wanted.

That generosity is real. They want you to feel special because they know how good it feels.

If you are with a Leo, let yourself be celebrated. And remember to celebrate them back.

lines.text: Leo will forgive almost anything except being ignored.
lines.caption:
Fights a Leo can handle. Disagreements, even mistakes.

What cuts deep is indifference. Being overlooked. Being treated like background. Being treated like the room would have been exactly the same without them.

The sun cannot stand being hidden behind a cloud.

If you love a Leo, notice them. Ask about their day. Watch their thing. React to their news. Attention is not vanity to them. It is how they know they are loved.

lines.text: Behind every loud Leo is someone who just wants to hear they did well.
lines.caption:
Leo performs confidence. And often it is real. But there is a tender spot underneath.

They want to know they are doing well. That their effort was noticed. That the risk they took was worth it. Under the big personality is a child holding up a drawing, waiting for someone to look.

They will not always ask. Asking feels like admitting doubt.

So tell them, unprompted. You did well. I'm proud of you. Watch how quickly the sun comes out.

lines.text: Leo loves like the sun shines. Generously, daily, and a little bit at you.
lines.caption:
The sun does not shine selectively. It warms everything.

Leo loves the same way. Friends, family, partners, strangers who need a laugh. Their generosity is a big part of who they are. They are the friend who pays for dinner and remembers everyone's birthday, loudly.

And yes, they like you to notice the warmth. To turn your face toward it.

It is a fair trade. Few signs give so much light. All they ask is that you enjoy it out loud.

lines.text: Virgo shows love by fixing things. Let them. It's their version of a poem.
lines.caption:
Virgo is mutable earth, ruled by Mercury. Practical, detailed, devoted.

They may not write you a love letter. But they will fix your shelf. Book the appointment you kept forgetting. Bring the plaster before you knew you needed it.

That is their romance. Care in action.

If you are with a Virgo, notice the small things they do. Every one of them is a sentence in a very long poem.

lines.text: A Virgo notices everything. The trick is letting you see that they adore it.
lines.caption:
Virgo sees the details. Your new haircut. The slight change in your mood. The typo in your text.

That attention is a gift. But Virgo sometimes only voices the critical part. The praise stays in their head and only the corrections make it out loud.

The truth is, most of what they notice, they love. Your habits. Your little rituals. The things nobody else sees.

Virgo, say those things too. Let people know your attention comes from affection, not inspection.

lines.text: Virgo isn't cold. They're just checking that it's real before they hand it over.
lines.caption:
Virgo can seem reserved at first. Careful. Measured.

That is because they take love seriously. They want to understand what it is before they give it away. They read the small print on a relationship the way other signs read the headline.

Once they are sure, their devotion is quiet but total.

If you are courting a Virgo, be consistent. Be honest. Show up when you said you would. They are watching, and they are rooting for you to pass.

lines.text: Nobody is harder on a Virgo than a Virgo. Be the soft place.
lines.caption:
Virgo has an inner editor that never sleeps. Every mistake replayed. Every flaw listed.

They can be critical of others. They are far harsher with themselves. Every small mistake becomes evidence in a trial that only they are attending.

The partner who wins a Virgo is often the one who shows them grace. Who says it is fine when they are spiralling. Who loves the imperfect version.

Be their soft place. They will make your life work beautifully in return.

lines.text: Virgo, you are allowed to be loved while you're still unfinished.
lines.caption:
Virgo wants to get it right. Better body, better job, better habits. Then, maybe, they will be ready for love.

But that day never quite arrives, because there is always something to improve. One more course, one more fix, one more month of getting it just right.

Here is the truth. Nobody wants a finished project. They want a person.

Virgo, let someone see the draft. You might find they love it exactly as it is.

lines.text: Libra will say anywhere is fine. Anywhere is not fine. Ask again.
lines.caption:
Libra is cardinal air, ruled by Venus. Harmony matters to them deeply, sometimes more than their own dinner order.

So they compromise. They go along. They pick whatever restaurant you like. They say anywhere is fine, then quietly hate the restaurant all evening.

But every unspoken preference adds up. Eventually the peace they kept starts to feel like a prison.

If you love a Libra, ask what they want. Then wait, properly, for the answer. Having a preference is not starting a fight.

lines.text: Libra makes everyone feel like the favourite. The one who gets them is the one who notices.
lines.caption:
Libra is charming. They make people feel seen and special. It is a genuine gift.

But it can mean that nobody looks after them in return. They are so busy balancing everyone else.

The partner who wins a Libra is the one who notices. Who asks about them. Who makes them the favourite for a change.

Turn the attention back to Libra. They will be surprised how much they needed it.

lines.text: Libra falls in love with beauty. They stay for fairness.
lines.caption:
Venus gives Libra an eye for beauty. A gorgeous face, a lovely room, an elegant gesture.

That might be what draws them in. But it is not what keeps them. A pretty face can get a first date. Only a fair one gets a second year.

What keeps a Libra is fairness. A relationship where both people give. Where arguments are resolved, not won.

The scales are their symbol for a reason. Balance is their love language.

lines.text: A Libra hates conflict so much they'll stay in a slow ending. Help them say it.
lines.caption:
Libra will do almost anything to avoid hurting someone.

That is kind. It is also how they end up in relationships that faded long ago but never ended. They would rather endure a slow fade than deliver one clear, painful sentence.

They are waiting for a moment when it can be done gracefully, without anyone being upset. That moment rarely comes.

Libra, a clear ending is a kindness too. Hurting someone gently is better than wasting both of your years.

lines.text: Libra doesn't want a partner. They want a partnership. There's a difference.
lines.caption:
Many signs want someone to love. Libra wants someone to build with.

Equal effort. Shared decisions. Two people on the same team, choosing each other. Not a fan, not a project, not a rescuer. An equal who shows up with half the plan.

Libra rules the seventh house, the house of partnership. Working together is in their nature.

If you want a Libra, do not just admire them. Collaborate with them. Show them you are in it as equals.

lines.text: Scorpio doesn't trust easily. When they do, it's the whole vault.
lines.caption:
Scorpio is fixed water, ruled by Mars and, in modern astrology, Pluto. They feel deeply and protect fiercely.

They will not open up to just anyone. They watch. They wait. They test. They are not being cold. They are checking whether you can be trusted with something heavy.

But when a Scorpio finally trusts you, there is no halfway. You get the secrets, the history, the devotion.

It is a lot to be given. Hold it carefully. They do not hand it out twice.

lines.text: A Scorpio can forgive you. They just won't pretend it didn't happen.
lines.caption:
There is a myth that Scorpio never forgives. Not quite true.

They can forgive. But they do not erase. The memory stays, and with it, the lesson. Water remembers the shape of every stone that was ever thrown into it.

That is not holding a grudge. It is refusing to be naive.

If you have hurt a Scorpio and they have stayed, take it seriously. You have been given a second chance by someone who rarely gives them.

lines.text: Scorpio tests you because they've been fooled before. Pass, and they're yours.
lines.caption:
Scorpio has a sixth sense for lies. Partly intuition. Partly experience.

So they test people, sometimes without meaning to. A small push to see if you will stay. A question to see if you are honest. They are not trying to catch you out. They are trying to stop being caught out themselves.

It can feel unfair. It comes from having been hurt.

Be consistent. Be truthful. Do not take the tests personally. Scorpio is looking for someone who will still be there after the storm.

lines.text: Scorpio would rather have one real thing than ten easy ones.
lines.caption:
Casual is not really in the Scorpio vocabulary.

They are not interested in surface level. Small talk bores them. Half-hearted connection frustrates them. They would rather have one conversation that changes them than a hundred that pass the time.

They want depth. Truth. Something that feels like it matters.

That makes them choosy. It also makes them one of the most devoted partners in the zodiac. If a Scorpio is giving you their time, you are already one of the real ones.

lines.text: Under the Scorpio stare is someone hoping you won't leave once you see everything.
lines.caption:
Scorpio has a reputation for intensity. Piercing eyes, guarded heart, mystery.

But what is underneath is surprisingly tender. A fear that if someone truly saw them, all of them, they would leave. So they reveal themselves slowly, a room at a time, watching how you react.

That is why they hide. Why they test. Why they hold back.

If you love a Scorpio, stay through the reveal. Let them see that the truth about them is not a dealbreaker.

lines.text: Sagittarius isn't scared of commitment. They're scared of a smaller life.
lines.caption:
Sagittarius is mutable fire, ruled by Jupiter, the planet of expansion.

They get labelled as commitment-phobic. The truth is more specific. They fear any love that makes their world shrink. Less freedom, less laughter, less room for the person they are still becoming.

Fewer adventures, fewer ideas, fewer horizons.

The partner who keeps a Sagittarius is the one who makes life bigger. Book the trip together. Learn something new together. Then watch how happily they stay.

lines.text: A Sagittarius will tell you the truth even when you were hoping for a nice lie.
lines.caption:
Honesty is the archer's arrow. It flies straight, sometimes faster than intended.

A Sagittarius will tell you if they think you are wrong. If the outfit is not working. If the plan has holes. The archer does not aim to wound. They just never learned to bend the arrow.

It can sting. But you will never have to wonder what they really think.

In a world full of polite evasions, that is a gift. Let it land. They mean it kindly.

lines.text: Sagittarius falls for minds first. Bring a good argument and a passport.
lines.caption:
Jupiter rules philosophy, travel and big ideas. That is the Sagittarius love language.

They are drawn to people who teach them something. Who can debate. Who have stories from somewhere else. A Sagittarius will forgive a messy flat long before they forgive a dull conversation.

Looks might start the conversation. Curiosity keeps it going.

If you want to keep a Sagittarius, do not settle into routine. Keep learning, keep exploring. Bring them along.

lines.text: Sagittarius, the best trips have a second ticket. Buy it.
lines.caption:
The archer loves freedom. New cities, open roads, the next big thing.

Sometimes they treat love as something that would slow them down. They pack light, leave early and tell themselves travelling alone is the whole point.

But the best adventures are shared. The sunset means more when someone you love is standing next to you, laughing at the same moment.

Sagittarius, you do not have to choose between freedom and love. The best trips have a second ticket. Buy it for someone who wants to wander with you.

lines.text: Sagittarius laughs through almost everything. Notice when they stop.
lines.caption:
Sagittarius is the optimist of the zodiac. They find the joke in the disaster. They keep the mood up.

That is lovely, and it can hide a lot. The laugh is real, but sometimes it is also a very good way of changing the subject.

If your Sagittarius goes quiet, if the jokes stop, something is wrong. They are not good at saying so directly.

Sit with them. Ask. The archer needs someone who knows that laughter is not always the whole story.

lines.text: Capricorn doesn't say I love you until they've built something to put it in.
lines.caption:
Capricorn is cardinal earth, ruled by Saturn. Structure, responsibility, long game.

They do not rush declarations. Words are commitments, and Capricorn takes commitments seriously. Saturn rewards patience, and Capricorn courts the way they climb mountains, one secure step at a time.

Before they say it, they want a foundation. Trust. Plans. Proof that this is real.

When a Capricorn finally tells you they love you, believe it. It was not said lightly. It was built.

lines.text: A Capricorn will show up in a crisis. Let them show up when it's easy, too.
lines.caption:
Capricorn is the person you call when things fall apart. Calm. Practical. Already making a plan.

But they often forget that love is not only for emergencies. They know how to be needed. Being wanted for no reason makes them a little nervous.

They can be so busy being useful that they never let themselves just be wanted.

If you love a Capricorn, invite them to do nothing. A slow dinner. A lazy morning. Remind them that they matter even when nothing needs fixing.

lines.text: Capricorn has a five-year plan and no idea how they feel today. Ask them.
lines.caption:
Saturn makes Capricorn disciplined. Work first. Five-year plan second. Feelings when there is time.

The problem is that there is never quite enough time. Next quarter. After the deadline. Once things calm down. Things rarely calm down.

So emotions pile up in a waiting room. And Capricorn carries on like everything is fine.

If you love one, ask how they really are. Then wait. They might not answer straight away. But they will remember you asked.

lines.text: Capricorn isn't cold. They're just protecting the thing they took years to build.
lines.caption:
Capricorn can seem guarded. Slow to warm. Careful about who they let in.

That is because they have built a life with effort. Every brick earned. Late nights, careful savings, years of quiet work nobody clapped for.

They are not going to let just anyone walk in and rearrange it.

Patience and consistency win a Capricorn. Show them you value what they have built. Then offer to help build more.

lines.text: Capricorn ages backwards. Serious at twenty, silly at forty. Stick around.
lines.caption:
There is an old astrology saying that Capricorns age in reverse. Saturn rules them, and Saturn rewards time.

They are often old souls when young. Responsible early. Worried about the future. They were the kid who worried about the bills and planned the family holiday.

Then, as the work pays off, they loosen up. The humour comes out. They finally relax.

If you meet a young Capricorn, be patient. The best version is often still on its way.

lines.text: Aquarius loves you in their own way. You might need the instruction manual.
lines.caption:
Aquarius is fixed air, ruled by Saturn and, in modern astrology, Uranus. Original, independent, unpredictable.

They do not always love in the expected ways. Less flowers, more sending you an article they knew you would like. Less cuddling, more defending your weird idea in public. They will remember the thing you said you cared about and quietly fight for it.

It is still love. It just needs translating.

Learn their language. It is one of the most loyal dialects in the zodiac.

lines.text: Aquarius is a friend first. If they're not your friend, they're not your person.
lines.caption:
For Aquarius, friendship is the foundation of everything. Romance without it feels hollow to them.

They want someone they can talk to for hours. Laugh with. Disagree with. Plan the future of the world with. Romance is the extra layer. Friendship is the building it sits on, and they check the foundations first.

If you skip the friendship and go straight to romance, they may drift.

Be their friend. Truly. The rest tends to follow.

lines.text: Aquarius will debate the future of humanity and dodge one question about their feelings.
lines.caption:
Aquarius values independence. Space to think. Room to be themselves.

But sometimes that space becomes a hiding place. When things get emotional, they step back. Analyse instead of feel. They will talk about systems, ideas, anything but the one question you actually asked them.

It can look like calm. Often it is protection.

Aquarius, staying in the room when it gets personal is not losing yourself. Answer the one question. It is how someone gets to love the real you.

lines.text: An Aquarius won't be jealous. They'll just quietly expect you to be as free as they are.
lines.caption:
Aquarius dislikes possessiveness. They will not track your location or demand to know where you were.

They give freedom easily. And they expect the same. To them, love is a choice made freely every day, not a lock on the door.

That can feel like detachment to some signs. It is actually trust.

If you want an Aquarius, do not cage them. Let them come and go. They always come back to the people who let them be themselves.

lines.text: Aquarius doesn't care what people think. They care a lot about what you think.
lines.caption:
The water bearer is famously unbothered. Trends, opinions, what the neighbours say.

But there is a short list of people whose opinions matter deeply. If you are on it, you have real influence. They will shrug off a stranger's criticism and lie awake over one honest word from you.

Aquarius just will not always show how much your view means.

Be kind with that power. Tell them what you admire. They will act like it is nothing. They will remember it forever.

lines.text: Pisces falls for who you could be. Show them who you are, early.
lines.caption:
Pisces is mutable water, ruled by Jupiter and, in modern astrology, Neptune. Dreamy, intuitive, romantic.

They see the best in people. Sometimes the best that is not quite there yet. They fall for the sketch and fill in the colours themselves, beautifully and sometimes inaccurately.

That makes them generous. It also makes them vulnerable to loving potential instead of reality.

If you love a Pisces, be real with them. Show them the true you early. They will love that more than any fantasy.

lines.text: Pisces feels what you feel before you've said it. Don't bother pretending.
lines.caption:
Pisces absorbs the emotional atmosphere like a sponge. They know you are upset before you do.

So saying you are fine when you are not does not really work. They can feel it. Your mood arrives in the room before you do, and they have already started worrying about it.

It is better to just be honest. They will not judge. They will understand.

With a Pisces, the truth is easier than the act. And they are one of the safest places to tell it.

lines.text: Pisces disappears instead of saying no. If they've gone quiet, they're scared to hurt you.
lines.caption:
Pisces hates conflict and hates causing pain even more.

So instead of a clear no, they sometimes fade. Slower replies. Vaguer plans. A gentle drift. They are hoping you will get the message without them ever having to send it.

It is not cruelty. It is avoidance.

Pisces, you can say no kindly. A clear answer is more compassionate than a slow disappearance. The people who love you can handle the truth.

lines.text: A Pisces will love you like a song. Make sure they're in the chorus too.
lines.caption:
Pisces love is romantic and total. They write you into their world like music.

But they can forget themselves in the process. Giving everything. Asking for nothing. The fish swims wherever the current goes, even when the current is someone else's needs.

A healthy relationship with a Pisces makes room for their needs too. Their dreams. Their feelings. Their quiet moments.

Love them back loudly. They deserve to hear their own name in the song.

lines.text: Pisces, you keep falling for the trailer. Watch the actual film.
lines.caption:
Neptune gives Pisces a gift for imagination. They can see the whole film from a two-minute trailer.

In love, that can turn into staying for who someone might become. Waiting for a version that may never arrive. Pisces keeps the ticket and waits for the sequel that was never actually announced.

It is beautiful to believe in people. It is painful to love a ghost.

Pisces, look at what is real. Today. Watch the actual film, and love the person who is already showing up in it.
